test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Knowlege**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is Knowledge.
 
• **Knowledge** means **information gained through experience and education**.
 
 
• Example, ***Mia gained this knowledge by working in France for two years***.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marinate** is correct. To marinate means** to soak**.

 
 
• Example, ***some food dishes require to marinate them overnight.***
 
 
 
• **College** is correct.** A college is an educational facility where students get work ready**.
 
 
• Example, ***Picking a college is always a tough decision for students***. 
 
 
 
• **Jocular** is correct. Jocular is used as an adjective for **funny**.
 
 
• Example, ***there is always someone in every class to make jocular comments***.
